summary: The 8-K reports a special servicer transition for a mortgage loan in the BANK 2020-BNK29 securitization. Effective September 1, 2026, Greystone Servicing sold its special servicing division to C-IV Asset Management, which assumed all duties under the pooling and servicing agreement. C-IV AM is a wholly-owned subsidiary of C-IV Capital Partners and retained substantially all key employees. This is a servicing-asset sale, not a corporate merger or securities event. No financial terms were disclosed. Watch for continuity of loan administration and any future servicing-transfer notices.
